description: Use this when the user wants Fantasy Premier League players that fit a brief: 'best midfielders under £7m', 'cheap defenders for the next 3 gameweeks', 'differential forwards under 10% owned', 'best Arsenal players', 'replacement for Isak under £8m'. Ranks by our model's predicted points for next gameweek, or by price, form or ownership; horizon adds each player's fixtures for up to 6 gameweeks. Also finds a player by name. Ranking over several gameweeks is in FPL Cat Pro.

club.description: Club name or short name, e.g. 'Arsenal' or 'ARS'.

horizon.description: Gameweeks of fixtures to show, 1-6. Default 1. The ranking is always next gameweek's.

includeDoubtful.description: Include players under 50% to play. Default false.

maxOwnership.description: Only players owned by at most this % of managers.

name.description: Look a player up by name instead (the other filters are ignored).

name: find_players
title: Find FPL players
